headline: Quiet close to the month; slow fading continues
body: A quiet day with no scored events. The only movement came from earlier announcements fading, which took about 0.02 off Protector God, Gatekeeper and the endings that need powerful AI, with similar tiny drifts in the world factors. The window ends with Enslaved God still on top and the mood a little darker than a month ago. Horizon Balance holds at +2.10.
movers_note: Only small drifts as earlier news faded: Protector God -0.02 and Gatekeeper -0.02.
